title: Ceramide synthesis mediates colorectal cancer metastasis through a YAP-driven regenerative program
title_zh: 鞘脂酰胺合成通过 YAP 驱动的再生程序介导结肠直肠癌转移
abstract: Mechanisms by which primary tumor cells acquire metastatic capability through metabolic and signaling adaptations are currently poorly understood. We demonstrate that tumor-intrinsic ceramide metabolism, amplified by dietary fat, initiates colorectal cancer metastasis. We observed that dietary fat exposure triggers a sustained increase in de novo ceramide biosynthesis, mediated by the dihydroceramide desaturase Degs1 . Ceramide accumulation activates yes-associated protein (YAP) through protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A)–mediated dephosphorylation, promoting a durable shift toward a distinct YAP-driven regenerative (YAP-DR) program, marked by Basp1 , that promotes metastasis. Selective elimination of Basp1 high cancer cells prevented metastatic seeding. Degs1 loss reduced ceramide levels, YAP activity, YAP-DR signatures, and metastasis without affecting primary tumor growth, whereas blocking ceramide degradation enhanced YAP activity and metastasis. These findings identify ceramide-induced YAP signaling as a key mediator of metastatic initiation, operating independently of primary tumor expansion.
abstract_zh: 目前尚不清楚原发肿瘤细胞通过代谢和信号适应获得转移能力的机制。我们证明，肿瘤内在的鞘脂酰胺代谢在膳食脂肪的放大作用下启动结肠直肠癌转移。我们观察到膳食脂肪暴露触发了持续的脱氧鞘脂酰胺新生合成增加，这一过程由二氢鞘脂酰胺脱饱和酶 Degs1 介导。鞘脂酰胺积累通过蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）介导的去磷酸化激活 yes‑associated protein（YAP），促进向一种独特的 YAP‑驱动再生（YAP‑DR）程序的持久转变，该程序以 Basp1 为标记，促进转移。选择性消除 Basp1 高表达的癌细胞阻止了转移种子形成。Degs1 缺失降低了鞘脂酰胺水平、YAP 活性、YAP‑DR 典型特征和转移，但不影响原发肿瘤生长；相反，阻断鞘脂酰胺降解增强了 YAP 活性和转移。这些发现表明鞘脂酰胺诱导的 YAP 信号是转移启动的关键介质，且与原发肿瘤扩张独立运作。
